title: ServiceNow Review (2026)
intro: ServiceNow is evaluated here as an IT service management (ITSM) / employee service desk platform — ServiceNow is the enterprise Now Platform for ITSM (incident, problem, change, request, CMDB) plus a broad module catalog (ITOM, HRSD, CSM). ServiceNow does not publish list prices. From April 2026 ITSM is licensed Foundation / Advanced / Prime with Now Assist allocations bundled. Third-party benchmarks often cite roughly $100+/fulfiller/month list at small bands before discount — treat as directional, not a SoftwareGlimpse floor. Implementation and module sprawl dominate TCO versus Freshservice’s published agent SKUs. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose ServiceNow when enterprise ITSM (and likely adjacent Now modules) is the job and you can run an RFP — not when you need Freshservice’s published Starter SKU.
verdict: Choose ServiceNow when enterprise ITSM (and likely adjacent Now modules) is the job and you can run an RFP — not when you need Freshservice’s published Starter SKU. Compare Freshservice for published mid-market ITSM; Jira Service Management if you already live in Jira Cloud. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Enterprise platform UX and implementation burden — productive after SI/config, not in an afternoon. Not hands-on lab tested.
Canonical enterprise ITSM — ranked with Freshservice and JSM, not against Datadog or GitHub.
ITIL-depth CMDB, change, and cross-module workflows are the category ceiling.
Broadest enterprise integration surface in the ITSM cluster.
Enterprise controls, domain separation, and compliance are core.
Built for global fulfiller counts and multi-module estates.
Quote-only + implementation is the TCO story; not comparable to $19 Freshservice Starter. Affiliate economics excluded.
Now Assist bundled by 2026 tier; Prime gates custom agents. Scored as assistance, not a ChatGPT substitute.

bestFor: Enterprises standardising ITSM (and often HRSD/CSM) on one platform
ITIL-mature shops that need CMDB + change at scale
Buyers with budget for implementation partners
notIdealFor: SMBs that need a published $19/agent ITSM SKU (Freshservice)
Atlassian-first teams that only need JSM on an existing Jira Cloud
SRE teams buying observability (Datadog / New Relic)
limitations: No published self-serve price — procurement and SI partners are the buying motion
Implementation cost often exceeds year-one licences
Module sprawl (ITOM, HRSD, CSM) can dwarf ITSM seat cost
Poor fit as an SMB published-price alternative to Freshservice Starter
Not an observability, git, or hosting-panel product
pricingSummary: Contact sales. Foundation / Advanced / Prime ITSM with bundled Now Assist. No public list price — confirm quote and AI assist pools.
whoShouldChoose: Choose ServiceNow when enterprise ITSM (and likely adjacent Now modules) is the job and you can run an RFP — not when you need Freshservice’s published Starter SKU.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Compare Freshservice for published mid-market ITSM; Jira Service Management if you already live in Jira Cloud.

faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
